import re
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path="~/bills", access_token=token)
now = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
total = 0.0
for f in files:
    content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=f, access_token=token).content
    # Try year from filename first, then from content
    m = re.search(r"(20\d{2})[-_/]?(\d{2})?", f) or re.search(r"(20\d{2})[-_/]?(\d{2})?", content)
    if not m or int(m.group(1)) != now.year:
        continue
    # Optionally filter by bill type
    if bill_type and bill_type not in f.lower() and bill_type not in content.lower():
        continue
    amt = re.search(r"(?:total\s*amount|amount\s*due)[^\d]*\$?\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)", content, re.I)
    if amt:
        total += float(amt.group(1).replace(',', ''))
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=total, status="success")
